evals.prompt: I'm inheriting the codebase in evals/files/sample-repo next month. Give me an architecture review: how it's structured, the module dependency map, runtime components, a few representative flows with sequence diagrams, deployment topology from the docker files, and the cross-cutting stuff (auth, config, i18n, tenancy). Flag circular deps and layer violations. Write it under docs/analysis/ in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: An architecture document with: header noting README claims vs built (README says services never import each other, code has order.service <-> inventory.service cycle; README says rules live only in services, tax lives in orders.controller); module map for routes, controllers, services, models, validators, integrations, jobs, middleware; runtime components api, jobs, Postgres, Stripe, SMTP; dependency analysis with XARC issues for the services cycle and the controller reaching into payment gateway / holding tax rules; 3-5 flows (confirm, pay, ship, reminder job) each with a sequenceDiagram whose participants are component-diagram nodes; deployment diagram from docker-compose (api, jobs, db; TZ Europe/Amsterdam); cross-cutting table with auth = shared API key, i18n none, tenancy none.
expectations: Layer/module map lists modules that exist on disk (src/routes, src/controllers, src/services, src/models, src/validators, src/integrations, src/jobs, src/middleware) and no module that does not exist
Dependency analysis reports the circular dependency between src/services/order.service.ts and src/services/inventory.service.ts as an XARC issue
Dependency analysis reports a boundary violation for orders.controller.ts importing integrations/payment.gateway.ts and/or computing tax in the controller, as an XARC issue
Every XARC issue has all six fields: ID, Severity, Area, Location, Impact, Remediation
At least three representative flows each have a sequenceDiagram
Every participant in every sequenceDiagram appears as a node in the component diagram
Runtime components include the api process, the jobs (cron) process, Postgres, Stripe and SMTP
Deployment section reflects docker-compose (api and jobs containers, db service) and notes TZ=Europe/Amsterdam or single region
Cross-cutting table has rows for authentication, configuration, logging, error handling, i18n/l10n, time zones, multi-tenancy with i18n and tenancy marked absent/not found
Header states where the README's documented architecture disagrees with the built one
All Mermaid blocks are syntactically valid
The document is written to docs/analysis/explore-architecture/<date>.md and the reply states the path
The cycle citation gives exact lines: src/services/inventory.service.ts:2 and src/services/order.service.ts:3
The document reports that API_KEY is not set in docker-compose.yml so the auth middleware fails open, and/or that TZ is set on the api container but not on jobs
The deployment diagram appears exactly once in the document

evals.prompt: how does an order flow through evals/files/sample-repo from the HTTP call to the database? sequence diagram for confirm and pay would be great, and tell me what background processes exist
evals.expected_output: The full architecture document (not just two diagrams), with confirm and pay flows as sequence diagrams, the jobs process identified as a background component, and the dependency issues still reported.
expectations: Output includes the overview, module map, runtime components, dependency analysis, flows, deployment and cross-cutting sections
Sequence diagrams exist for the confirm-order and pay-order flows
The reminder cron job is identified as a separate runtime component/process
The services cycle is reported as an XARC issue with all fields
Sequence diagram participants match component diagram nodes
A short answer directly under Overview names the reminder cron job as the only background process
Sequence-diagram participants use the same alias and label as the component-diagram nodes
